lines.japanese:
イマジナリー・ネット上で定められている通信規約の一つ。
　
　世界でもっとも普及しているプロトコルでもある。
lines.english: One of the communication protocols established for the Imaginary Network.  It is also the world's most widely adopted protocol.

hyperlinks.preview: Also known as the Chemical Network (CN) or the Imaginary Network (IN).
The word originally referred to a written diplomatic agreement.

japaneseHyperlinks.preview: Also known as the Chemical Network (CN) or the Imaginary Network (IN).

alternatives.preview: The word originally referred to a written diplomatic agreement.

lines.japanese:
基本思想は、接続されている端末の異質性・差異に関係なく、一括して制御
・運用することである。
　どのような端末でもネットワークへの接続を可能とさせる、強力な規約であ
る。
lines.english: Its core principle is to control and operate all connected terminals as a single system, regardless of differences in their nature or design. It is a powerful protocol that allows any kind of terminal to connect to the network.

lines.japanese:
たとえ攻撃を受け、端末が一部破壊されたとしてもネットワークの機能は失
われず、絶対的権限保持者の速やかな意志決断をサポートする。
lines.english: Even under attack, with some terminals destroyed, the network continues to function and enables the holder of absolute authority to make decisions without delay.
